The lamp itself is beautiful - the design is as I expected. It looks stunning in my space and feels warm. 
The only small thing I would mention is the switch button, which is positioned quite far from the lamp and fairly low on the cord. It’s not a major issue, but it’s something to be aware of depending on where you plan to place it.

I would also like to point out that the shipping experience to the Czech Republic was absolutely catastrophic – and this is NOT the seller’s fault. Česká pošta took a week and a half to deliver the package, and the whole process was very frustrating. I strongly recommend considering alternative carriers for deliveries to the Czech Republic, such as Zásilkovna, DPD, or PPL. 
Overall, I truly love the lamp and would definitely recommend the seller - just hopefully with a different shipping provider
